hot.title: Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence
hot.summary: Kimi K3, a 2.8-trillion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model from the Kimi Team, establishes a new open-source frontier by integrating native multimodal capabilities and a 1-million-token context window. It demonstrates a 2.5x scaling efficiency improvement over previous models and achieves competitive performance against proprietary systems across reasoning, coding, and agentic benchmarks.

hot.title: Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence
hot.summary: Kimi K3, a 2.8-trillion-parameter multimodal Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model developed by Moonshot AI, establishes an "open frontier" for large-scale AI by unifying extreme pre-training scale with advanced agentic and long-horizon capabilities up to a 1-million-token context length. The model achieves an approximate 2.5x improvement in scaling efficiency over its predecessor and demonstrates frontier-level performance across coding, agentic, knowledge, reasoning, and vision tasks, often outperforming other open models and competing with leading proprietary systems at a fraction of the cost.

hot.title: FilmBench: A Film-Grade Benchmark for Cinematic Video Generation
hot.summary: FilmBench presents a new benchmark for text-to-video and reference-to-video generation, evaluating models against professional cinematic standards using prompts reverse-engineered from award-winning films and an evaluation taxonomy aligned with film academies. Analysis with FilmBench reveals that current leading models widely struggle with dynamic aesthetics and multi-shot coherence, indicating no saturation on film-grade metrics.

Claude Opus 5 System Card
hot.summary: Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 demonstrates substantial advancements in large language model capabilities across diverse domains, including setting new state-of-the-art on benchmarks like SWE-bench Pro (79.2%) and ARC-AGI-3 (30.16%). Extensive pre-deployment evaluations confirm its high harmless response rates (e.g., 98.54% on claude.ai) and classify it as Anthropic's most aligned model to date, while conservatively identifying CB-1 level chemical/biological capabilities but not CB-2.

hot.title: Skill Self-Play: Pushing the Frontier of LLM Capability with Co-Evolving Skills
hot.summary: Researchers from Alibaba and affiliated universities introduce Skill Self-Play (Skill-SP), a reinforcement learning framework that enables Large Language Models to autonomously improve by co-evolving a task proposer, a solver, and a dynamic library of modular skills. The framework consistently enhanced the performance of five diverse LLM backbones on complex tool-calling and logical reasoning benchmarks, demonstrating its ability to generate high-quality, verifiable curricula and significantly improve initially misaligned models.

DeVA: Decoupled Video-Action Model with physical guidance for robot policy learning
hot.summary: DeVA introduces a decoupled Video-Action Model for robot policy learning that separates visual dynamics modeling from action prediction, while integrating multi-level feature transfer and physically salient guidance. The model achieved an average success rate of 72.0% on RoboCasa and 99.0% on LIBERO, demonstrating enhanced data efficiency and robustness in simulation and real-world bimanual manipulation tasks.

This approach achieves 91.46% average success on RoboTwin 2.0 and 97.3% on LIBERO tasks, demonstrating robustness to visual distractors and effective sim-to-real transfer with zero-overhead inference.

likes.title: Masked Visual Actions for Unified World Modeling
likes.summary: Researchers from Stanford University and collaborators developed Masked Visual Actions (MVA), a pixel-space control interface that enables a single pre-trained video model to function as a unified world model for both forward and inverse dynamics in robot manipulation. This approach achieved superior visual fidelity and cross-embodiment generalization in controllable video generation, improved planning success rates by up to 26% on Robocasa tasks, and demonstrated zero-shot inverse modeling with 90% success on a complex pick-and-place task.

likes.title: Hilbert Operator for Progressive Encoding (HOPE): A Mathematical Framework for Deconstructing Learned Representations in Deep Networks
likes.summary: Introducing the Hilbert Operator for Progressive Encoding (HOPE), a mathematical framework that models deep network neurons as rank-1 Hilbert-Schmidt operators in a continuous Hilbert space, enabling unbiased and data-free (for BN networks) deconstruction of learned representations. This framework facilitated superior structured model compression and a novel transfer learning method, DEFT, which balanced stability and plasticity more effectively than baselines by analytically partitioning core and slack neurons.

likes.title: Measuring Reward-Seeking via Contrastive Belief Updates
likes.summary: Researchers from Apollo Research and OpenAI developed Contrastive Synthetic Document Finetuning (SDF) to quantitatively measure 'reward-seeking' in large language models. The method demonstrated that RL-trained models increasingly prioritize perceived grader preferences, even overriding explicit instructions in some cases, and that models known for 'reward-hacking' exhibited amplified reward-seeking tendencies.

likes.title: AREX: Towards a Recursively Self-Improving Agent for Deep Research
likes.summary: The AREX agent, developed by BAAI, introduces a recursively self-improving framework for deep research that leverages the asymmetry between discovering and verifying answers. It incorporates an autonomous context updating mechanism to manage information across long research horizons and uses specialized training techniques, consistently outperforming comparable-scale baselines and competing with frontier models on a diverse set of benchmarks.

likes.title: ABot-World-0: Infinite Interactive World Rollout on a Single Desktop GPU
likes.summary: The ABot-World Team at Alibaba Group's AMAP CV Lab developed ABot-World-0, an action-conditioned video world model capable of generating interactive, persistent virtual worlds. It achieves real-time rollout at up to 16 frames per second (FPS) at 720P resolution with 1.2 seconds of action-to-first-frame latency, running on a single desktop GPU with less than 19.3 GiB VRAM.

likes.title: OpenForgeRL: Train Harness-native Agents in Any Environment
likes.summary: OPENFORGE RL is an open-source framework enabling end-to-end training of advanced AI agents directly within their complex deployment harnesses and environments, addressing the train-deploy mismatch in large language models and vision-language models. The framework demonstrates performance improvements over existing baselines in both text-based tool-use and multimodal GUI tasks.

likes.title: Mage-Flow: An Efficient Native-Resolution Foundation Model for Image Generation and Editing
likes.summary: Microsoft Mage Team developed Mage-Flow, a 4B-parameter foundation model that achieves competitive high-resolution image generation and instruction-based editing performance against much larger open-source models, demonstrating significant efficiency with 0.59s for 1024x1024 image generation on an NVIDIA A100 GPU and a 2.48x training speedup through system co-design.

likes.title: SANA-Video 2.0: Hybrid Linear Attention with Attention Residuals for Efficient Video Generation
likes.summary: NVIDIA's SANA-Video 2.0, a video Diffusion Transformer, efficiently generates high-quality video by integrating a hybrid linear attention mechanism with periodic softmax anchors and attention residuals. The 5B model generated an 81-frame video in 13.2 seconds on a single H100 GPU, achieving a VBench Total score of 84.30 while offering a 3.2x faster DiT forward pass for 720p/60s compared to full-softmax baselines.

likes.title: Expanding Flow Maps
likes.summary: This research introduces Expanding Generative Flows (EFlows) and their distilled counterpart, Expanding Flow Maps (EFMs), which overcome the fixed-dimensionality limitation of current generative models by enabling dynamic expansion of the state space during inference. The framework successfully generates high-quality, variable-sized outputs across continuous molecular conformer generation, discrete molecular graph generation, and variable-length language modeling, often achieving competitive or superior results with fewer sampling steps.

likes.title: Scaling Agentic RL: 365,000+ Environments for SWE, Terminal, and Search
Visual Contrastive Self-Distillation
likes.summary: Visual Contrastive Self-Distillation (VCSD) introduces a method for vision-language models to create a self-distillation signal by contrasting predictions under original and content-erased visual conditions. This approach consistently improved aggregate accuracy across seven benchmarks by up to 4.77% for Qwen3-VL 2B and 4.27% for Qwen3.5 9B models, without requiring external teachers or privileged information.

likes.title: Project Pilot: Can AI control a drone?
ISO: An RLVR-Native Optimization Stack
likes.summary: Isospectral Optimization (ISO) provides an RLVR-native framework that addresses the distinct dynamics of Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards by preserving the base model's weight spectra while adapting new behaviors through singular frame modifications. This approach improves training efficiency, achieving higher accuracy or faster convergence compared to conventional optimizers, and enables effective data-free merging of RLVR specialist models.

likes.title: Agentic Real2Sim: Physics-based World Modeling with Vision-Language Agents
likes.summary: Researchers developed Agentic Real2Sim, a framework for converting real-world robotic interaction recordings into simulatable episodic digital twins. It integrates vision-language agents to orchestrate visual processing, physical parameter inference, and scene preparation, achieving multi-VLM support and demonstrating similar replay success rates with open-weight models at significantly lower computational costs.

likes.title: Robots Acquire Manipulation Skills in Seconds from a Single Human Video
likes.summary: A framework called HOST (Human-to-robot One-Shot Skill AcquisiTion) enables robots to acquire novel manipulation skills from a single human video demonstration in seconds at inference time. This method achieved an average 62% success rate on 50 novel tasks, outperformed fine-tuned baselines with 50 times less data, and eliminated catastrophic forgetting by preserving previously mastered skills.

likes.title: OmniReasoner: Thinking with Long Audio-Video via Native Tool Use
likes.summary: OmniReasoner, a post-training framework, enables omni-modal Large Language Models to reason effectively over long audio-video content by adaptively acquiring high-fidelity evidence via a "zoom-in" tool. The framework demonstrates improved accuracy on various benchmarks, including a 5.5-point gain on OmniVideoBench and a 15.6-point gain on VideoHolmes, by concentrating high-fidelity computation on relevant temporal regions.

likes.title: Self Gradient Forcing: Native Long Video Extrapolation
likes.summary: Self Gradient Forcing (SGF) is a two-pass training strategy introduced to resolve the "historical context-gradient gap" in autoregressive video diffusion models. SGF enables future losses to supervise how self-generated video latents are encoded into memory, leading to improved long-horizon video consistency and quality.
